title: The role of molecular gas in the nuclear regions of IRAS 00183-7111. ALMA and X-ray investigations of an ultraluminous infrared galaxy
question: To what level can the molecular gas, traced by CO, be responsible for the AGN obscuration seen at X-ray energies in the ULIRG IRAS 00183-7111

what.value: Radio data and spectral index (0.84-87 GHz) alpha=-1.38 for SED

evidence.quote: reported a radio spectral index (in the range 0.84$-$87 GHz) $\alpha=-1.38$

what.value: Dust absorption coefficient k_o at 2141 GHz

evidence.quote: we assumed the value of k$_{o}$ tabulated by (cite: Li01) at the reference observed frequency $\nu_{o}=2141$ GHz
*NuSTAR* data were obtained by courtesy of the PI (K. Iwasawa; see (cite: Iwasawa17) for details)

recipe.method: Recalibrate from ASDM, combine same-configuration datasets, CLEAN continuum (natural and robust 0.5) with phase-only self-cal

recipe.goal: Make CO cube and moment 0, measure flux and size
recipe.method: uvcontsub, CLEAN cube at ~90 km/s, masked moment 0, 2-D Gaussian fit for size
Solomon05 L'CO formula; M(H2)=alpha L'CO; Carilli13 L_IR relation; SFR=delta_MF x 1e-10 L_IR

recipe.goal: Fit dust SED to estimate thermal contribution
recipe.method: Single-temperature modified blackbody to Herschel data, extrapolate to ALMA frequencies
key_parameters: beta fixed 1.5; Td and Md free

recipe.goal: Fit X-ray spectra and compare NH with molecular column
recipe.method: XSPEC fits of Chandra, XMM, NuSTAR individually and jointly with XILLVER; molecular NH from uniform sphere
key_parameters: Gamma fixed 1.9; inclination fixed 87 deg; errors 90% confidence
assumptions: uniform sphere of radius median of axes (6.4 kpc)

evidence.quote: the SFR results to be $260\pm28$ M$_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$
The observed offset is 0.53"$\pm$0.08" ($\sim7 \sigma$), corresponding to $2.5\pm0.4$ kpc.

not_stated_but_needed: Clean iteration limits, cell and image sizes
Herschel flux densities used in SED fit
Exact CASA flux model library version
score_reason: ALMA data public and recipe mostly described with numeric results, but several imaging parameters and Herschel inputs are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public Cycle 0 data, stated CASA workflow, and numeric CO flux, mass, SFR and offset results.
